title.en: Old Scholar in a Vaulted Chamber (St Anastasius)
title.sv: En lärd gammal man i ett välvt rum (Den helige Anastasius)

identity.artist: Rembrandt Harmensz. van Rijn; former attribution: Circle of Rembrandt

works.selectionRationale: Useful for the Dutch old-master route and for testing how the museum presents changing attribution within a canonical collection display.
works.riskRationale: The official record retains Rembrandt as artist but also records a former Circle of Rembrandt attribution and explains the changed assessment.

title.en: The Three Graces with a Basket of Roses

identity.artist: Peter Paul Rubens, Workshop of; Jan Brueghel the younger

works.selectionRationale: Represents Flemish Baroque painting, workshop production and the museum’s long Swedish collecting history in the 17th-century galleries.
works.riskRationale: The official record identifies the work as workshop of Rubens and discusses collaboration and attribution limits.

title.en: King Candaules of Lydia Showing his Wife to Gyges
title.sv: Kung Kandaules av Lydien visar sin hustru för Gyges

works.selectionRationale: Adds a large narrative painting to the Dutch and Flemish seventeenth-century sequence and broadens the story beyond the best-known names.
works.riskRationale: No additional risk flagged at discovery.

works.selectionRationale: Represents Larsson’s integration of painting, relief and illustration, and the official Stockholm turn-of-the-century display context.

identity.artist: Edward Hald; made by Orrefors, engraved by Wilhelm Eisert

works.riskRationale: No additional risk flagged at discovery.

title.en: Study for the Painting Bathers at Asnières 1884
title.sv: Studie för målningen Badarna i Asnières 1884

works.selectionRationale: A documented French drawing candidate that connects the museum’s historical graphic-art collecting to a modern European master and a known painted source.
works.riskRationale: The official record documents the object and image but marks it not on display, so a visitor-facing presentation requires confirmation.

title.en: Design for Decoration for the Hall of State, the Royal Palace, with the Royal Throne
title.sv: Ritning till kortsidan av Rikssalen, Stockholms slott med den kungliga tronen

identity.artist: Pehr Estenberg, after Louis Jean Desprez
identity.medium: Pen and grey-black ink with wash on paper

works.selectionRationale: A research candidate for the graphic-art and architectural-design dimension, tying museum holdings to Stockholm Palace and theatre-influenced Neoclassicism.
works.riskRationale: The official record marks the drawing not on display; its inclusion is contingent on a later main-building presentation check.
